relations.zotero_refs: [CTAI38G9]: 931. Lineage of the Pramāṇaviniścaya (ID:3774) according to Bu ston (ID:5999): Parahitabhadra (ID:3798), Blo ldan shes rab (ID:3786), [Khyung] Rin chen grags pa (ID:3809), [Phya pa] Chos kyi seng ge (ID:3831), brTson 'grus seng ge (ID:3839), Chos kyi grags pa (in other lineages, Dan 'bag pa (ID:3840) is placed between gTsang nag pa and gNyal zhig), 'Jam pa'i rdo rje (ID:3887), brTson 'grus rdo rje (ID:4296), Rin chen dpal (maybe Bo don rin chen (ID:3904)), Don grub seng ge (ID:7764), bSod nams mgon po (ID:6925).

comments:
In the teaching lineage of Zang rings grags pa dar ma tshul khrims (ID:4011) ([8GL7ZT7Y]: 25, translated from [8GL7ZT7Y]: 15a3).
See [CTAI38G9]: 924 on his nicknames "tshad ma'i skyes bu" and "rigs thigs pa," and his dates, proposed to be ca. 1235-1315, considering that he was teaching at Khro phu in 1307 and taught until his 83rd year.

[CTAI38G9]: 928 defends the idea that "Tshad ma'i skyes bu" is bSod nams mgon po and not Don grub dpal, another teacher of Bu ston (ID:5999).
